takeaways: An agent is a model plus instructions plus tools, and it carries a task through several steps instead of stopping at one reply.
Foundry Agent Service handles everything around the model, including tools, memory, identity, hosting, evaluation and observability.
Copilot Studio is the low-code door and Foundry the pro-code door into the same platform, so teams can start light and scale up.
hook: Turning an AI model into an agent that actually does work sounds like a job for developers and servers. This beginner-friendly episode explains what Microsoft Foundry Agent Service is, how models, tools, memory and hosting fit together, and when to choose it over Copilot Studio.
